source_scope: Middle view only. The independent review accepted its grip/thumb anatomy as concept reference, not measured geometry. The other inconsistent views are excluded.
generation_scope: One bounded single-view local Hunyuan3D-2.1 shape experiment, same pinned tool/checkpoint as original guard. Result is an unverified sculpting source, never a finished hand or fitted rig.
preprocess: Exact middle-view crop, magenta classification, one-pixel boundary erosion, opaque foreground alpha, zero hidden RGB; original raw preserved.
preprocess_exception: Binary alpha and disclosed one-pixel contraction are allowed only for neural shape input; not a runtime sprite/texture cutout.
qa_gates: Four fingers and one opposable thumb
Credible palm/thumb web and knuckle rhythm
No hand/handle fusion accepted as final geometry
Preserve original separate metal plates and leather regions
Both visible and inferred sides independently reviewed
Actual final grip fit measured against final weapon
non_claims: Input views are not metrically registered
Single-view inference cannot prove hidden anatomy or commercial readiness
No skeleton, animation, UV or runtime publication in this experiment
